ground_truth_use: evaluation only; no GT input to E3 segmentation or E4 region selection/refinement
depth_source: Replica office0 depth frame paired with E1 keyframe frame_id
depth_resampling: nearest neighbor using DUSt3R long-edge-512 resize and 16-pixel-compatible center crop geometry
metric: same-pixel Euclidean distance between pointmap point and GT depth backprojection after one global Sim(3) fit on B0 only
sim3_fit_pixels: deterministic 2x2 checker lattice, then reuse transform for every method
threshold_status: descriptive pilot threshold; no validation selection or efficacy claim
